issues.description: The problem statement and the template declare `ratings` as a `var` property on `Course` (implying it is accessible as declared), but the solution marks this property as `private var ratings`. This is a visibility change between template/problem and the solution. While encapsulation is reasonable, this divergence may confuse students expecting to access or inspect `ratings` directly following the problem description.
issues.suggested_fix: Make the desired visibility explicit in the problem statement and template. If `ratings` should be encapsulated, update the problem statement and the template to declare it as `private var ratings` (and teach students to use the provided methods to interact with it). If direct access is intended, change the solution to keep `ratings` non-private.
